title: Astro Portal open session package manifest (v1)
description: The public, versioned manifest at the root of an astro-session-package/ directory. Astro Sync is only one producer: a personal script or another astronomy application may write this file directly and have the portal import it. This manifest never carries an authoritative session id or tenant/organization id -- the importer's session is always the one named by the import request (POST /v1/sessions/{id}/imports/preview|confirm), resolved from the caller's authenticated membership, never from a value read out of this file. Checksums live in the sibling checksums.sha256 file (plain sha256sum format, one '<hex digest>  <relative path>' line per asset), not in this JSON; verifying every listed asset against it before import is mandatory. See README.md in this directory for the full package layout and the hard rules importers must enforce.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC, with an explicit offset (e.g. "2026-09-20T21:04:00Z").

relativePath.description: Forward-slash separated, relative to the package root. No leading slash, no drive letter, and no "." or ".." segment: rejected by this pattern outright, so an importer's own independent traversal check (resolving the path and asserting it stays under the package root) is a second line of defense, never the only one.

asset.description: One file the package carries, in addition to being listed in checksums.sha256.

bytes.description: Exact file size in bytes -- not kilobytes, not an estimate.

capturedAt.description: When the underlying observation was captured; null when not applicable (e.g. a derived metrics file).

addedAt.description: When this asset was written into the package.

session.description: Descriptive-only reference to the observation night this package documents. Deliberately carries no id, account, or tenant/organization field: the portal always associates an import with the session named by the import request, never a value read from the package, so a package cannot claim to belong to a session or account it was not explicitly imported into.

producer.description: Free-form, informational only. Identifies which tool wrote the package (Astro Sync's CLI or GUI, or a personal script) for troubleshooting; never used for authorization.

packageVersion.description: The manifest contract's own version, distinct from `producer.version`. This schema only validates packageVersion 1.

assets.description: At least one asset is required: the minimal package is a versioned manifest plus one asset. Metrics, events, and progressions are additional assets, all optional.
